record.question: Which country is known as the land of 'thousand lakes'?
record.explanation: Answer C: Finland. Finland is conventionally called the land of a thousand lakes. Finland's official country-information service explicitly records this epithet; thousand is a nickname, not an exact lake count. Reference: https://toolbox.finland.fi/themes/nature-and-sustainable-development/land-thousand-lakes/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
